visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video utilizes a split-screen layout. The top half features a vibrant 90s-style animation from the Dragon Ball GT series, showing Goku emerging from a pink creature in a forest setting. The bottom half shows a woman with long black hair sitting at a black grand piano in a studio. She is dressed in a red, white, and blue cosplay-style top, denim shorts, and a long red animal tail accessory. The background consists of grey vertical sound-absorbing panels. (2) In the top animation, the scene shifts to characters flying through a purple sky toward a large yellow sun. Below, the woman focuses on her performance, her fingers moving precisely across the black and white piano keys. Her posture is upright, and she is seen from a side profile. The lighting is bright and uniform across both panels, emphasizing the textures of the piano and her clothing. (3) The animation transitions through several action-packed sequences, including characters in futuristic vehicles and a close-up of a character with purple hair. The pianist continues her performance with rhythmic consistency, her upper body swaying slightly. The split-screen remains the primary visual structure until the video fades out at the conclusion of the musical piece.
